indicator_rule: Indicators meet Gentry's test. Lists stay flat, not tiered by time (Grabo). Readouts count changed indicators per hypothesis; there is no weighted threat score. Judgment calls (identity, attribution, defunct status) go to data_quality_findings for a person, never to a rule.
emerging_concerns: A group name with no record claims its first victims: Vigil queues the identity question (new group, rebrand or alias) in data_quality_findings. It becomes a tracked actor once the finding is decided, and the queue entry is dropped after 60 days with no further claims.

indicators.rule: >= 3 victims claimed in the last 7 days and > 1.25x the 7 days before; active groups only

indicators.text: A victim's own filing confirms a claim
indicators.rule: an SEC 8-K Item 1.05 or state breach notice matched to the claimed victim

indicators.text: Claims arrive in a batch rather than spread over the week
indicators.rule: more than half of a group's claims for the week share one discovered_date (planned: not yet computed)

indicators.text: A leak-site feed is late or failing
indicators.rule: the feed has missed its expected interval

indicators.text: CISA adds a vulnerability to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
A known-exploited vulnerability with known ransomware use reaches EPSS 0.5
indicators.rule: EPSS >= 0.5 on a current score (epss_date within 3 days, migration 159), KEV-listed, ransomware use known

indicators.text: The EPSS score behind an alert is not current

warning_problems.title: An extortion group's surge (any group)
warning_problems.issue_on_change: Issue a notice only when a group starts or stops escalating; stay silent while it holds.
warning_problems.deactivation: A group returns to normal after two weeks without VG-IND-1.

hypotheses.statement: The group is attacking more victims
A backlog, re-posts or a rebrand: old victims published at once
Artefact or data failure (a scraper outage ending, duplicates)

warning_problems.title: Broad exploitation of a newly listed vulnerability
warning_problems.issue_on_change: Issue a notice when a KEV entry with ransomware use first reaches EPSS 0.5; stay silent while it holds.
warning_problems.deactivation: Back to normal when the current EPSS score falls below 0.5.

hypotheses.statement: Broad exploitation is likely within 30 days
Exploitation stays limited to targeted use
Artefact: a stale or mis-joined EPSS score
